data.name: WelcomeNote_Content
data.value:
# Welcome to Enki
This is my personal knowledge workspace. I can write notes in Markdown, organise tasks with Kanban boards, manage reminders, and connect ideas together in sessions.
**Get started:** - Create a note from the Notes view. - Add a task in the Polar view. - Switch between sessions from the Sessions view.
Happy writing.
